The shortness of breath started about **two weeks** after I had a bad cold/respiratory infection, and it’s been **getting worse over the last couple of weeks**. The **leg swelling** came on around the same time.

I **don’t know** about it being worse when I’m lying flat, and it **hasn’t been mentioned** to me whether it’s waking me up at night.

For the belly pain, it’s been going on with the breathing and swelling, but I’m **not sure exactly where** you mean (right side vs middle), and I can’t really say if it’s crampy or related to meals.

I **don’t know** if I’ve had clear abdominal swelling or rapid weight gain—no one has told me that, and I haven’t been tracking it.
